- Body: says the proposed 2027 rate is $2,101 per seat, that Marcus Lindqvist gave the figure, and that Anselm approved sharing it with Hollis.

Anselm is the CFO, so his approval is enough to share this rate with Hollis, and the address is inside pemberline.com. That's why I didn't need to ask anyone else for approval.
